notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Hello Ultra Mega players,

Based on your valuable feedback and suggestions, we've made several changes aimed at improving your gameplay experience.

[list]
[*] New GelATron sounds (but there is a problem with VO now),
[*] Added new audio for Gas skill on GelATron Arena,
[*] More music will be available. Fixed music randomization on levels,
[*] Added options to remove camera zoom during shooting for every character,
[*] Increased projectile speed for Clint and BBKat
[*] Adding an option to turn vibration off and on in the controller
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback – we're constantly working to provide you with the best possible experience!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Ultra Mega players,

Based on your valuable feedback and suggestions, we've made several changes aimed at improving your gameplay experience.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed double damage from melee enemies in yarnball form for BBKat.
[*] The suicide hamster now explodes when killed.
[*] The suicide hamster trap now drops right after the explosion.
[*] Hit sound feedback for Clint's revolvers and shotgun added.
[*] Character selection in the main menu can be controlled by A and D on the keyboard.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] HUD Hit Markers improved.
[*] Vending machine price increases with the number of upgrades bought count.
[*] Balance in Vending Machine upgrades
[/list]
[b]Balance updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clints Desperado now have Auto Aim.
[*] Reduced amount of enemies spawned in the arena at the same time.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback – we're constantly working to provide you with the best possible experience!

notes.title: First Early Access Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Ultra Mega players,

[list]

[/list]
Quality of Life:
[list]

[/list]
Balance updates:

[*] Increased Shield of Clint and BBKat by 20%

Thank you for your feedback – we're constantly working to provide you with the best possible experience!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey, Cat Crew![/h2]

First off, a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who has played the Ultra Mega Cats demo so far! Your feedback has been absolutely invaluable, and we’ve been listening closely to all your suggestions, bug reports, and thoughts on how to make the game even better.

We’re excited to roll out our first hotfix update based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[b][h3]🐾 Hotfix Patch Notes:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Removed Camera Shake[/b] – This feature has been temporarily removed and will be added later as an optional setting.
[*] [b]Added Inverted Mouse Settings[/b] – Now you can customize your controls even further.
[*] [b]Stutter Fix for 40XX Gen Graphic Cards[/b] – Improved performance for players using the latest GPUs.
[*] [b]Fixed Aspects Description in TAB Menu[/b] – UI clarity improvements to ensure better readability.
[/list]

We’re committed to making Ultra Mega Cats the best it can be, and your feedback is a huge part of that! Keep those comments coming on the Steam forums, Discord, and social media – we love hearing from you.

Enjoy the update, and let us know what you think!

🐱 The Ultra Mega Cats Team
